summary: A 41-year-old Gypsum man was reported missing the evening of July 4, 2022 after struggling in the water and disappearing while attempting to cross the Colorado River about 6 miles north of Dotsero. A multi-day search by Gypsum Fire Protection District, Vail Mountain Rescue Group, Eagle County Sheriff's Office, Summit County Water Rescue Team and others located his body in the river around 2 p.m. July 7; he was pronounced dead at the scene.
location: Colorado River ~6 mi north of Dotsero
responding_agency: Gypsum Fire Protection District; Vail Mountain Rescue Group; Eagle County Sheriff's Office; Summit County Water Rescue Team; Eagle County Paramedic Services; Eagle County Coroner's Office
notes: Date is the body-recovery/search-conclusion date (July 7, 2022); the man was reported missing the evening of July 4, 2022 after disappearing while crossing the Colorado River north of Dotsero.
